gpu_cases.oracle: unbounded integer value, binary search nearest BF16 value, ties to even

diagnosis: The original Q norm and BF16 rotary coefficients place first*cos exactly at a BF16 midpoint. Its tiny negative BF16 cross term selects the lower BF16 endpoint. FP32 FMA first discards that term and selects the even upper endpoint. All complete original K/V match; exactly one Q cell differs; replaying that actual Q reproduces all20 context endpoint differences.
candidate: Use a single-round BF16 FMA endpoint in prefill and decode RoPE. Preserve the ordinary FP32 fast path away from BF16 midpoints and use bounded integer alignment with sticky rounding at midpoints and edge cases. Legacy full-FP32 coefficients retain their prior arithmetic.
